verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms docs.zapier.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented index of developer documentation covering the SDK, MCP and integration building. Zapier also publishes an llms-full.txt and markdown (.md) versions of its doc pages, such as the SDK quickstart, CLI and MCP connect guides, which agents can ingest directly. Missing for 10: first-party guidance explicitly telling users how to point an agent at llms.txt, and independent user reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
